autoregressivo.d: Generating one token at a time: each chosen token is appended to the sequence and becomes input to the next step. Every step costs a full forward pass through the model, and the loop is sequential by nature.

logits.d: Raw scores, one per vocabulary token, that the lm_head produces from the final hidden state (z = W_U·h). They can be negative and only their differences matter. The softmax turns them into probabilities.

logprob.d: Natural logarithm of a token's probability, log pv = zv − LSE(z), measured in nats. It is what the API returns in logprobs and what gets compared in numerical parity tests.

entropia.d: H = −Σ p·log p: the uncertainty of the next-token distribution, in nats. e<sup>H</sup> is the “effective number of choices”: ≈1 when the model is sure and large when it hesitates.

temperatura.d: Divides the logits before the softmax (z/T). T<1 concentrates mass on the favorite, T>1 flattens the distribution and T=1 is the learned distribution. In vLLM, T=0 is treated as greedy. It never changes the order of the tokens.

greedy.d: Always picking the token with the highest logit (argmax), equivalent to T=0. There is no draw, and it is used in benchmarks, but it is prone to repetition loops and is only reproducible if the logits are bit-for-bit identical.

amostragem-top-k.d: Keeps only the k most likely tokens before the draw and renormalizes. The size is fixed and blind to the confidence of the step. Qwen uses top_k=20 in its generation_config. Not to be confused with the MoE top-k of experts.

amostragem-top-p.d: Keeps the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability reaches p and renormalizes. The size adapts to confidence. GLM and Qwen inherit top_p=0.95 from the checkpoint.

amostragem-min-p.d: Keeps the tokens with a probability of at least min_p × p(favorite). It adapts to confidence and needs no sorting. In vLLM it is applied before top-k/top-p (in both model runners).

softcap-logits.d: Soft ceiling z → c·tanh(z/c): it barely touches small logits and keeps any logit from going past ±c. It must be applied at inference exactly as in training. DFlash2 anticipates final_logit_softcapping in dflash_config (0 = off).

gumbel-max.d: argmax(z/T + g), with g = −log(−log u) and u uniform, produces an exact sample of softmax(z/T) with a single reduction, without normalizing and without synchronizing with the CPU. With T=0 it becomes plain argmax. It is the draw used by the vLLM Model Runner V2 sampler (Triton kernel in gumbel.py, with an FP64 option) and by the DFlash2 candidate selector. Model Runner V1 uses the equivalent form argmax(p/E), with E exponential.

penalidade-repeticao.d: Adjustments to the logits of tokens already seen. repetition_penalty r is multiplicative (it divides positive logits and multiplies negative ones, over prompt and output). presence_penalty λpres subtracts a fixed value and frequency_penalty λfreq subtracts λfreq × count, both over the output only. The neutral values are 1, 0 and 0.

loop-de-repeticao.d: When generation recycles the same material indefinitely, because each repetition makes the next one more likely. It is common in greedy or at low temperature. Raising max_tokens does not help.

min-tokens.d: Sampling parameter that masks the end tokens until N tokens have been generated. In the recipes' benches it comes paired with an equal max_tokens, to pin the length.

ignore-eos.d: Makes the engine keep generating even after an end token. It is meant for fixed-length decode benchmarks and never for production.

seed-amostragem.d: Number that pins the sampling noise of a request. In the vLLM Model Runner V2 the noise is counter-based: each row's seed comes from (seed, position) and each token's uniform is indexed by its id, so the draw is reproducible regardless of the batch. Identical text still requires identical logits.

determinismo-bit-a-bit.d: The guarantee that the same input produces exactly the same bits at the output. In parallel inference it requires fixing the order of the reductions. In Qwen, the sorted QSA top-k and the non-fused MoE finalize cost ~4%. Deterministic does not mean exact.

finalize-moe.d: The stage that combines the outputs of each token's k experts into a sum weighted by the router weights. When fused into a kernel it may sum in a variable order. VLLM_MOE_DET_FINALIZE=1 (Qwen) uses the non-fused, fixed-order version.

modelo-de-raciocinio.d: A model trained to write a draft of its thinking between <think> and </think> before the answer. Thinking tokens are ordinary tokens: they cost the same and consume max_tokens.

reasoning-effort.d: Reasoning effort level that the chat template turns into text in the prompt (a directive). It does not touch the sampler. The accepted values change by family: GLM low/high/Max, Qwen low/medium/xhigh, DeepSeek low/high/max. Changing the effort changes the beginning of the prompt and invalidates the prefix cache.

thinking-token-budget.d: A limit on the thinking tokens only. At the limit step, the logit row is masked to force </think>, leaving the rest of max_tokens for the answer. In DeepSeek it is opt-in (DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE31_GPU_HOTFIX=1) and implemented with GPU kernels.

novidade-8-gramas.d: Fraction of the word 8-grams in a window (700 words) that have not appeared earlier in the trace. It is the metric of loop_detector.py: below 2% for 3 windows, with no recovery, indicates a loop; staying high until the end indicates a long tail.

amostragem-por-rejeicao.d: Verification rule that accepts draft x with probability min(1, p(x)/q(x)) and, on rejection, samples from the normalized residual max(0, p − q). It preserves the target distribution exactly. The expected acceptance is Σ min(p, q) = 1 − TV(p, q).

amostragem-chaveada.d: A draw in which each token's Gumbel noise is a pure function of (key, absolute position, token id), with no state. In TensorFold the key is the request's seed or, without one, a SHA-256 hash of the prompt ids, and the choice runs in float64 on the host. The same request gets the same reply, and verifying a draft becomes comparing tokens.

splitmix64-chave.d: A 64-bit mix (xorshifts and multiplications by odd constants) used as a hash: applied three times over (key, position, token), it gives a uniform number in (0, 1) without keeping any state. Any input can be looked up directly, in any order, with the same result.

invariancia-de-lote.d: Property of an engine in which a row's bits do not depend on the other rows processed with it (batch, verification window, other requests). It requires a fixed partition of reductions (split-K, tiles), atomics only on integers and cross-GPU sums in a fixed order. It is what lets TensorFold guarantee concurrent = alone.

verificacao-por-igualdade.d: TensorFold's speculative verification rule: the target samples every row of the window with keyed sampling, and drafts are accepted while they equal that sample. The reply is identical to serial decoding, whatever the drafter. Unlike rejection sampling with min(1, p/q), which only preserves the distribution.

acoplamento-gumbel.d: Making two samples agree by using the same Gumbel noise: the target chooses argmax(z<sub>p</sub>/T + g) and the drafter argmax(z<sub>q</sub>/T + g). If q ≈ p, the winners almost always match. Since that drafter samples from q, agreement never exceeds Σ min(p, q), the ceiling of any coupling. TensorFold's DFlash2 uses the target's noise with weight 0.7.
